wo-jpfa-JR1040.d:
Job Summary:**

Provide emergency medical care and pre-hospital treatment to employees at PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk's Bati-Bati facility, ensuring a safe and healthy working environment.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Respond promptly to medical emergencies, accidents, and illnesses within the company premises.
* Assess patient conditions, administer first aid, and provide advanced life support procedures as required, including CPR, wound care, and medication administration.
* Operate and maintain emergency medical equipment, including defibrillators, oxygen tanks, and stretchers.
* Transport injured or ill employees to appropriate medical facilities while providing ongoing care and monitoring.
* Document all patient care activities, medical histories, and treatment provided accurately and thoroughly.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and adequately stocked medical infirmary or clinic.
* Assist in developing and implementing health and safety programs and emergency response plans.
* Conduct regular health checks and screenings for employees as part of occupational health initiatives.
* Provide health education and awareness programs to employees on various medical topics.
* Collaborate with internal health and safety teams and external medical professionals when necessary.

Job Qualifications:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Nursing or Paramedical Science.
* Valid Paramedic license/certification in Indonesia.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Paramedic or in an emergency medical services setting, preferably in an industrial or corporate environment.
* Proficiency in administering first aid, basic life support (BLS), and advanced cardiac life support (ACLS) techniques.
* Strong knowledge of emergency medical protocols, procedures, and relevant regulations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Physical fitness and ability to lift and move patients and equipment.
* Proficiency in using medical equipment and maintaining accurate medical records.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including shifts and on-call duties, as needed.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. wo-jpfa-JR2900.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for the safe and efficient transportation and delivery of eggs from farm to various destinations, ensuring product integrity and timely distribution within the PNGKLN LADA region.

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate a company egg van safely and responsibly, adhering to all traffic laws and company policies.
* Load and unload egg products carefully to prevent damage and maintain quality.
* Verify accuracy of delivery orders and obtain necessary signatures upon delivery.
* Inspect vehicle pre-trip and post-trip, reporting any maintenance issues or damage promptly.
* Maintain cleanliness and proper sanitation of the delivery vehicle.
* Adhere to strict hygiene and biosecurity protocols when handling and transporting eggs.
* Communicate effectively with farm staff, customers, and dispatch regarding delivery schedules and any issues encountered.
* Complete delivery logs and other required paperwork accurately and legibly.
* Manage delivery routes efficiently to meet scheduled deadlines.

Job Qualifications**

* Valid HC (Heavy Commercial) driver's license in Indonesia.
* Proven experience as a commercial driver, preferably with experience in transporting fragile goods.
* Thorough understanding of traffic laws and regulations in Indonesia.
* Ability to lift and move heavy loads (e.g., egg crates) safely and repeatedly.
* Good physical stamina and health, able to work long hours and in various weather conditions.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding product handling and documentation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Reliable, punctual, and highly responsible.
* Knowledge of the PNGKLN LADA region is a plus.
